About $1,804 at 7:02 a.m. ET Monday, down 0.82% over 24 hours (TokenPost).

themes.title: Weakest week since early June
themes.summary: Bitcoin's weekly candle closed just under $65,000, the weakest week since early June, after a drop of just over 5% on Saturday; it remains about 49% below its October 2025 record of $126,080 (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Sentiment stuck at extreme fear
themes.summary: The Fear & Greed Index read 10 on Monday, unchanged from Sunday and down from 32 on Nov. 10; it has been below 20, the extreme-fear zone, since Friday (CryptoTicker). CoinMarketCap's own sentiment gauge read 12, also extreme fear (CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Most large coins slip
themes.summary: Of the 88 largest cryptocurrencies excluding stablecoins, 21 rose and 67 fell over the 24 hours to 7:02 a.m. ET Monday (TokenPost).

themes.title: ETF outflows extend
themes.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs had $185.4 million of net outflows on Friday, bringing seven-day outflows to about $1.91 billion and November outflows to more than $2 billion with no inflow days this month (Farside via CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Rate-hike pricing and AI stocks in focus
themes.summary: Markets fully price a December Fed hike (Reuters via Yahoo Finance), and Fed Chair Warsh speaks at noon ET Monday, ahead of Nvidia results Tuesday (CryptoTicker).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin was down 1.37% and ether down 0.82% over 24 hours as of 7:02 a.m. ET Monday (TokenPost).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: Losses were broad, with 67 of the 88 largest coins lower; Pepe fell 5.52% and Gate 5.49% (TokenPost).

categories.name: Infrastructure and enterprise tokens
categories.note: Canton rose 4.45% and XDC Network 3.94% (TokenPost); Quant gained 5.94% to $155.48 (CoinCodex).

categories.name: Derivatives and ETFs
categories.note: More than $2 billion of positions, mostly long bets, were liquidated over the weekend, and bitcoin ETFs logged $185.4 million of outflows Friday (CryptoTicker).

watch_list.why: The 24-hour low of $63,777 is the first reference point below, then Sunday's low of $61,946; the 24-hour high of $65,980 and the 200-week line near $67,800 sit above (CryptoTicker).
Flow figures for Monday's session are due Tuesday morning, after more than $2 billion of November outflows so far (CryptoTicker).

watch_list.topic: Warsh, Nvidia, Fed minutes and the Anthropic IPO
watch_list.why: Warsh speaks Monday, Nvidia reports Tuesday, Fed minutes are due Wednesday, Anthropic prices its IPO Nov. 18 with trading set for Nov. 19, and a Trump-Xi-Putin meeting is scheduled in China on Nov. 19 (CryptoTicker; CoinGabbar; Stockopedia).
